body: Fixed. `runFullBetaTextOnlyRuntimeSmoke` now wraps registry loading and sample execution, returns `status: fail` / `exit_code: 1` with `posture_map_load_failed:*` diagnostics for missing or malformed posture maps, and returns `no_samples_found_in_registry` when no deterministic text-only rows are available.

Fixed. Added regression coverage for missing posture maps, malformed JSON posture maps, and empty registries so the smoke runner fails closed without throwing and records the expected blockers plus zero-sample summary.
